usage: Use 深啡色 to talk about a dark brown colour, usually for things like hair, bags, shoes, and furniture. 例如：呢個袋係深啡色。
深啡色 can come before a noun to describe its colour. 例如：我想買深啡色衫。
When you want to compare shades, 深啡色 sounds deeper and darker than 啡色. 例如：佢塊木板係深啡色。
In everyday Cantonese, people often use 深啡色 for natural-looking dark brown tones. 例如：佢頭髮係深啡色。
